name: Default
shortDescription: Lightweight headless browser engine written in Rust, served as a Chrome DevTools Protocol endpoint for Puppeteer and Playwright scraping and AI agents.

alerts.message: Every request needs an Authorization: Bearer header with the generated OBSCURA_CDP_TOKEN from the environment settings. Connect Puppeteer or Playwright straight to wss://<your-domain>/devtools/browser: the /json/version discovery endpoint advertises a plain ws:// URL.
